generator.generation_rule: Fixed family/configuration matrix with seeded thresholds, bounds, and interior inputs; all emitted bodies use the existing typed constructor schema. No source parsing or unbounded random generation.

production_selection.method: deterministic stratified selection across template family, dependency topology, and numeric boundary arrangement
production_selection.note: Frozen stratified selection: the first two cases in each round-robin family, then family order repeats. Each selected case will be passed as a one-step host-owned Cycle19 sequence and its generated function constructor will traverse the actual TypeScript/JSONL bridge. The selected production tier tests creation authorization; rename and maintenance behavior remains covered by separate existing preflights and direct generated histories unless a generated contract is independently accepted by those gateways.

order: remove irrelevant constructor prefix only if failure remains reachable
move integer input toward closest comparison boundary

performance_regression_rule.baseline: Cycle38 generated replay/oracle median 24.7 ms per five-operation history (conservative minimum operation count from the documented five/six-operation workloads)
performance_regression_rule.suspicious_threshold: more than 2.0x the baseline upper bound, i.e. >9.88 ms per operation, confirmed by a second seven-run sample set
performance_regression_rule.scope: portable replay only; MIR batch, production bridge round-trip and gateway validation have no apples-to-apples Cycle38 substage baseline
performance_regression_rule.status: threshold registered after an exploratory Cycle39 timing run; exploratory samples are not used for regression classification; a fresh confirmatory run follows this registration
